mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 10.0%, it signals an economic emergency that triggers aggressive policy responses, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 55% of instances where UNRATE > 10.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) signals an imminent recession, prompting aggressive monetary policy that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 55% of instances where INDPRO and PAYEMS both decline by more than 2% in the past month, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime (defined by UNRATE > 10.0 and GDPC1 growth turning positive in the latest quarter), the market reacts positively to the recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances where UNRATE > 10.0 and GDPC1 growth is positive, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 (thousands) for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market, prompting policy intervention that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 55% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals that the Fed is not raising rates despite inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 55% of instances where RSAFS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic emergency, prompting aggressive policy responses that lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 55% of instances where UNRATE and INDPRO both decline by more than 0.5% in the past month, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
